description: This file implements a flash partition backend for storing and managing core dump data in Zephyr OS. It includes functions for opening, closing, reading, erasing, and verifying core dump data stored in a specific flash partition, along with shell commands for interacting with the backend.

methods.name: partition_open
methods.description: Opens the flash partition for coredump storage.

methods.name: data_read
methods.description: Reads data from the flash partition, optionally processing it via a callback.

methods.name: process_stored_dump
methods.description: Processes the stored coredump in flash via a callback.

methods.name: get_stored_dump
methods.description: Retrieves the stored coredump data or its size.

methods.name: erase_coredump_header
methods.description: Erases the coredump header from flash.

methods.name: erase_flash_partition
methods.description: Erases the entire flash partition used for coredump.

methods.name: coredump_flash_backend_start
methods.description: Begins a coredump session, erasing flash and initializing streaming.

methods.name: coredump_flash_backend_end
methods.description: Ends a coredump session, flushing data and writing header.

methods.name: coredump_flash_backend_buffer_output
methods.description: Outputs a buffer of data to flash, updating checksum.

methods.name: coredump_flash_backend_query
methods.description: Performs queries on the backend, such as error status or dump existence.

methods.name: coredump_flash_backend_cmd
methods.description: Executes commands like clear error, verify, erase, copy, invalidate.
